sources.title: Coinbase Stock Jumps 11.5% as Bitcoin Climbs Back Above $80K
passages: Market News Coinbase Stock Jumps 11.5% as Bitcoin Climbs Back Above $80K The rally came as the SEC introduced a temporary exemption for certain blockchain-based venues trading tokenized U.S. stocks.

Written By Iyiola Adrian Edited by Shubham Soni Published 19 hours ago · Updated 17 hours ago Make The Crypto Times preferred on G o o g l e Google Share Key Highlights COIN jumped 11.53% to $194.03, pushing its market cap to about $51.29 billion.
Bitcoin’s rise above $80,000 helped lift Coinbase and other crypto-linked stocks.
Coinbase filed to list more than 50 single-stock perpetual futures, including contracts tied to Nvidia, Microsoft, and Tesla.
Coinbase Global Inc. shares (COIN) jumped 11.53% during Friday’s trading hours, gaining $20.06 as crypto-linked stocks moved higher across the market.
According to data from Yahoo Finance (on September 18 at 7:10 PM UTC), COIN was trading for $194.03, pushing its market capitalization to around $51.29 billion with a trading volume of $15.1 million.

Coinbase share price (on September 18 at 7:10 PM UTC) | Source: Yahoo Finance The move was part of a broader rally in crypto-linked equities as investors responded to developments across the cryptocurrency and financial markets.
Bitcoin rally lifts Coinbase stock Bitcoin played a major role in the broader market move as it climbed above $80,000.
At the same time, a new Securities and Exchange Commission exemption opened a temporary path for some blockchain-based venues to trade tokenized U.S. stocks.
The move came after the Federal Reserve’s interest-rate decision earlier in the week, which kept the federal funds target range at 3.75%–4.00%.
As Bitcoin recovered, the move spread to companies whose businesses are closely linked to the crypto market.
Coinbase was among the stocks posting a strong gain, with its shares rising more than 11% during Friday’s session.
It also comes as the company continues to expand its trading and custody services.
Strategy stock also jumps Coinbase was not the only crypto-linked stock to post strong gains on Friday.
The Crypto Times reported that Strategy’s MSTR shares jumped more than 13% , rising from an intraday low near $137 to $150.89 before giving back some of the gains.
The broader move in Bitcoin and crypto-linked equities kept Coinbase in focus during Friday’s session, with COIN gaining 11.53% by the close.
